summary: Focused frontend re-test of the 3 minor issues fixed after iteration 2, plus a smoke pass on shift/barcode and a light regression. ALL PASS. FIX1 (stale shift state): opened a shift on /kasir (modal 100.000), closed it from a second tab on /kas (actual = expected 100.000, selisih Rp 0), returned to the first /kasir tab WITHOUT reload - stale green 'Kas terbuka' badge was still there (expected), added Burger Sapi, checkout-button + quick-exact + confirm-payment -> error toast 'Kas belum dibuka. Buka kas terlebih dahulu sebelum bertransaksi.' appeared, payment-modal closed automatically, shift-gate ('Buka Kas Dulu') re-appeared and the stale badge disappeared (badge count 0). FIX2 (barcode not found clears input): typing ZZZ-999 + Enter in product-search shows 'Barcode/SKU "ZZZ-999" tidak ditemukan', product-search is emptied and nothing is added to the cart. FIX3 (camera scanner no longer restarts): open-scanner opened scanner-modal, the video (Chromium fake device) rendered; three parent state changes were triggered while the modal was open (category tabs Makanan/Minuman/Semua) - modal stayed open, the scanner-video element was NOT remounted (marker property survived), no console errors at all, and modal-close closed it cleanly. SMOKE: BVG-001 + Enter added Kopi Latte (Rp 25.000) and cleared the search box; cash checkout with quick-exact (kembalian Rp 0) created receipt INV-20260802-0016; /kas active shift stats matched exactly (stat-opening-cash Rp 100.000, stat-sales-cash Rp 25.000 / 1 transaksi, stat-sales-noncash Rp 0, stat-expected-cash Rp 125.000); closing with the exact 125.000 gave difference-preview Rp 0, shift-summary showed Selisih Rp 0 and the history row shows Rp 0 with status TUTUP. REGRESSION: /transaksi lists 16 rows and view-receipt opens the receipt modal; /laporan renders all 3 charts (chart-omzet, chart-metode, chart-top-produk) as SVG; /stok Penyesuaian Stok modal dropdowns stock-product and stock-type both close after selecting (Burger Sapi (stok 17) / Stok Masuk (pembelian)) and do not block the fields below. Zero console errors across the runs except the expected HTTP 400 from the intentionally rejected create_transaction RPC.

issues: Carried over from iteration 2 (not re-tested this run): kasir role can see every cashier's shift history while the '(semua kasir)' label is admin-only
Carried over from iteration 1: native <input type=date> pickers instead of the design-system calendar

critical_code_review_comments: kasir/page.tsx muat() still ignores the shifts query error (sh.error): an RLS/network failure is indistinguishable from 'no open shift' and silently shows the blocking gate - low risk, optional

expected-cash on /kas is still computed client-side while the RPC recomputes it server-side; a sale landing between the two reads can make the previewed selisih differ from the stored one (unchanged from iteration 2, acceptable)

success_rate.frontend: 100% - 3/3 fixes verified + 6/6 smoke & regression checks passed

seed_data_creation: Created and closed 2 admin shifts (both modal 100.000, both closed with selisih Rp 0) and one real sale INV-20260802-0016 (Kopi Latte Rp 25.000, tunai) which cannot be deleted from the UI. Kopi Latte stock is now 36. No shift left open (verified /kas shows 'Belum ada kas yang dibuka'), tax 0, store name KasirPro Store, roles unchanged, no stock adjustment submitted (dropdown test cancelled).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Production build; restart with `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` (~60-90s) after code changes. Playwright note: page.context is a PROPERTY (page.context.new_page()), and on /kas the 'expected-cash' testid is a display <span> (parse rupiah text with re.sub(r'[^0-9]','',...)), while 'actual-cash' is the input. /stok dropdowns live inside the 'Penyesuaian Stok' modal - open it first, stock-product/stock-type are not on the page otherwise. rupiah() uses a non-breaking space, so compare with 'Rp\xa00' or normalize. Chromium's fake camera device makes scanner-video render a green test pattern, so the camera happy path is exercisable but real barcode decoding is not.
rca_of_the_issue: All three iteration-2 defects are resolved at the source: BarcodeScanner keeps onDetected/onClose in a ref with effect deps [open] (no camera restart on parent re-render), scanKode clears the search box on the not-found branch, and bayar()'s error branch closes the payment modal, nulls the shift state and re-runs muat() when the RPC message contains 'Kas belum dibuka', so the gate re-appears immediately.
